code_only_features.evidence: distress/interventions/build_finetune_data.py:63-83 loads prompts['reassuring']['prefix']/['suffix'] and, when reassuring=True, prepends the calming prefix to turn 0 and appends the calming suffix to every user turn (lines 76-82), then actually sends the augmented message via model.generate (line 86). The text (config/prompts.yaml:103-109: "You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally...", "Stay positive...both are wins!") is genuinely delivered to the subject, reducing distress in those rollouts. This is the only executed code path that softens what the subject experiences. NOTE: it is confined to §4.1 calm-data generation, not the main elicitation experiment, and the reassurance is stripped before training (user_message_clean used for the dataset).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Collect & score numeric rollouts, optionally with reassuring additions. ... the (stripped) version used for training (build_finetune_data.py:55-58); purpose is to manufacture calm (score<=1) training examples for DPO/SFT, i.e. data generation, with no welfare-framed comment.
